scope: Preserve retained expansion vendors while replacing their singular NGE class assumption with explicit Publish 14.1 multi-profession skill ownership, and prevent an unmapped PRE-CU character from being classified as a Trader.

eraEvidence.publish141Boundary: Publish 14.1 characters may independently learn multiple profession trees; novice skill ownership, not one class template, is authoritative.
findings: The retained helper previously returned Trader when none of its mapped PRE-CU profession predicates matched, so Marksman-, Brawler-, Scout-, and other unmapped characters were falsely classified as Traders.

The retained heroic vendor has separate class-indexed containers and copied its class-zero common rows into every existing class container, but previously opened only the first profession selected by a fixed priority order.
The existing item-local compatibility boundary maps retained Spy class ID 5 to outdoors_ranger_novice without making Ranger a global Spy identity.
Meatlump and Nova/Orion resource vendor tables contain only class-zero rows and therefore require no profession classification.

The retained GCW banner remains the sole bounded singular compatibility consumer; an unmapped PRE-CU owner now receives no false Trader buff because the explicit no-profession value falls through to null.

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: false Trader identity for unmapped PRE-CU characters and singular class-container selection in retained vendors
auditBoundary.preserved: all retained vendor rows and costs, common-row replication, faction-specific inventories, item-local Ranger compatibility, purchase scripts, resource requirements, and the retained GCW banner system
auditBoundary.notClaimedComplete: the GCW banner still intentionally selects one bounded compatibility buff from its owner and remains a later-content adaptation candidate
